svg.title: The simulated fly brain at rest, with flyvis's eyes: a dark disk looms at the left eye and the left looming detectors LC4 and LPLC2 light up over the resting activity
svg.text: The resting brain sees a looming disk
one fly: every neuron firing in each 80 ms lit; the left eye's looming detectors ringed
spikes per second, mean of 8 flies
